en: A sepia-toned historical photograph of a railway station building with a long platform canopy. A steam locomotive stands on the left side near the platform, and numerous people, including soldiers and civilians, are gathered along the platform in front of the station. The architecture is 19th–early 20th century European. At the top of the image there is printed text in Bulgarian Cyrillic.
